sql_templates.name: flow_regime_breadth_analysis
sql_templates.purpose: Analyze recent FII/DII flows, market regime, and breadth to evaluate the current market context.
sql_templates.sql:
SELECT
  f.trade_date,
  f.fii_net_5d,
  f.dii_net_5d,
  r.regime,
  b.advances,
  b.declines,
  i.close AS index_close
FROM
  signals.fii_dii_flows AS f
JOIN
  signals.regime_history AS r ON f.trade_date = r.trade_date
JOIN
  breadth.market_daily AS b ON f.trade_date = b.trade_date
JOIN
  market.index_eod AS i ON f.trade_date = i.trade_date
WHERE
  i.index_symbol = 'NIFTY 50'
  AND f.trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 week'
ORDER BY
  f.trade_date DESC;
